brief:

@buildthis.bisks.net prove you transcend humanity by creating a page to translate between rationalist jargon and cop speak. make sure to include zizian dialect terms along with the yudisms. 💜

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):

@playbypost.bsky.social: ngl it's wild seeing the psychotic cultists obsessed with proving their cult is not a cult
@segyges.bsky.social: cults are, by definition, bad. therefore we are not one
@octopodeeznuts.bsky.social: i need to dig up where the Knitting Cult Lady goes over her criteria for what makes a cult

the ones i had listed in an old comment were:

high entrance/exit cost
us-vs-them mindset
transcendent mission
ends justify means
worldview shift & sacred assumption
distinguishable vernacular
@segyges.bsky.social: when the cops arrested the zizians, they said they could not understand what they were saying and thought maybe they were speaking a foreign language

one notes that they are basically too esoteric + nuts to even coherently lodge an allegation with police
